components.name: App labeled input
components.description: Native field with the existing label gap, minimum height, and keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-app-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:#202c37;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55}.ds-app-field span{font-weight:600}.ds-app-field input{font:inherit;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#adb8c1);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:#202c37;caret-color:var(--accent,#17324d)}.ds-app-field input::placeholder{color:#687783;opacity:1}.ds-app-field input:hover{border-color:var(--control-hover,#7b8c99)}.ds-app-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3875a9);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: Context your AI agent can use
narrative.overview:
The public website explains visual feedback through warm paper, heavy Manrope type and coral accents. Plain language and one concrete illustrated request make the evidence and next action easy to understand. This refinement preserves the existing identity.

The application and extension keep their focused system-font interface, Oxford actions and existing theme behavior. Their density serves reviewing, setup and resolution. Each surface retains its own scale.
dos: Do preserve each surface's existing typography, palette and theme behavior.
Do use exact action labels and distinguish local drafts from sent feedback.
Do preserve original screenshot proportions and label illustrative evidence.
Do keep drafts safe during navigation and failed requests.
donts: Don't invent successful writes, automatic fixes, integrations or customer evidence.
Don't apply marketing display styles to the application or extension.
Don't treat reviewer guidance or weights as authorization.
